title: Riso
description: Twenty-eight two-ink project posters on a contact strip. Each poster prints in front of the visitor, and the Print stamp prints a real A4 copy.
signature: A roller lays the blue plate, then the pink plate lands off register and settles; the pointer moves the registration.
holdback: A visible Print this poster control produces an actual project artifact, confirmed by the print stylesheet. The large project title and separated ink edges make the poster legible as a concept on both sizes; the mobile capture also exposes the specific 972 KB to 337 KB result. It remains a familiar poster layout with a conventional index, and the misregistration is too slight to make the material treatment unmistakable. Strongest of this group, below distinctive-site territory.
slopCauses: The Archivo display face is shared with most reviewed directions.
